_readme: Grapheme-level vowel sets per language, keyed by short code.
Used by the future vowel-nucleus accuracy metric (chapter 4/6):
an inferred primary-stress interval 'hits' a vowel if the bulk
of its positive frames sits inside a graphAlign interval whose
HR, RS, and SI include 'r' because the South-Slavic family
treats syllabic /r/ as a valid nucleus (e.g. HR 'prst', 'vrh';
RS 'crkva'; SI 'vrt', 'trg', 'prst'). CZ and PL do not — their
orthographies use explicit vowel letters even for syllabic liquids.
Schwa lives in phoneAlign, not graphAlign, so it does not appear
here; a future phoneme-level dict (SI_phones etc.) can be added
at the bottom if we go phone-level for evaluation.
